cards.headline: Deep learning-based echocardiography for cardiac assessment

source.title: Deep learning-based echocardiography for cardiac assessment: a systematic literature review and meta-analysis.
source.excerpt: DL models achieve high performance across various applications in echocardiography. In selected tasks, they may reduce reliance on expert input and support greater automation of echocardiographic workflows. However, further validation, assessment of clinical utility, and evaluation in real-world settings are required before widespread clinical adoption.

cards.headline: The Liability for Damage Caused by the Use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in Medicine

source.title: The Liability for Damage Caused by the Use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in Medicine.
source.excerpt: Artificial intelligence has the potential to significantly enhance medical practice, its application must be accompanied by appropriate legal mechanisms that ensure patient protection and clearly define the responsibility of all participants in the system.

source.title: Izumo no Okuni
source.excerpt: Izumo no Okuni, häufig nur Okuni genannt, war eine japanische Künstlerin. Über ihr Leben sagen die noch erhaltenen Dokumente kaum Näheres. Sie wuchs wahrscheinlich in Izumo auf und soll am dortigen Schrein als Miko durch Tänze aufgefallen sein. Später lebte sie in Kyōto, wo sie eigenwillige Tanztheater-Stücke aufführte, die das Publikum als Kabuki bezeichnete.

cards.headline: AI-driven transcriptomics for neurodegenerative disease research: A systematic review

source.title: AI-driven transcriptomics for neurodegenerative disease research: A systematic review.
source.excerpt: Key translational hurdles include data scarcity in rare NDD subtypes, lack of cross-platform spatial benchmarks, and the black-box nature of deep neural networks. Integrating explainable AI (XAI) and prospective multi-modal cohorts is essential for translating computational transcriptomics into clinical diagnostics and targeted therapeutics.

source.title: Annie Oakley
source.excerpt: Annie Oakley war eine US-amerikanische Scharfschützin. International berühmt wurde sie durch ihre Auftritte in der Wildwest-Show von Buffalo Bill. Bis heute gilt sie als die weltweit erfolgreichste Frau in dieser Profession. In den USA gilt sie als nationale Ikone und Prototyp des All-American-Girl und erster weiblicher Superstar der Popkultur.

source.excerpt: Across the included studies, approximately three in 10 schoolteachers met the diagnostic criteria for MetS, although prevalence estimates varied widely across settings.

source.title: Artificial intelligence and biotechnology for smart storage: Quality and safety perspectives in horticultural produce.
source.excerpt: The effective implementation of these approaches holds considerable potential to reduce F&V waste, enhance food security, and create horticultural supply chains that are more resilient to ever growing global production and evolving environmental challenges.

source.title: An integrated AI-driven vaccine design process: a systematic review of workflows from generative design to translational prediction.
source.excerpt: Overall, this analysis served as a strategic roadmap for utilizing AI as a transformative framework for next-generation vaccine discovery and pandemic preparedness.

source.excerpt: AI-based medication recognition is evolving from a computer vision task into a digital informatics component supporting medication safety, accessibility, verification, and patient care.

cards.headline: Multimodal artificial intelligence in retinal vascular and neovascular macular diseases

source.title: Multimodal artificial intelligence in retinal vascular and neovascular macular diseases: a systematic review of diagnostic and prognostic applications.
source.excerpt: Multimodal AI demonstrates superior diagnostic and prognostic performance compared to unimodal models and, in some cases, outperforms expert clinicians in managing retinal vascular diseases. Integrating complementary data sources, such as OCT, fundus imaging, and clinical information, enhances model accuracy and generalizability.

source.excerpt: Future efforts should focus on reducing bias, improving generalizability and robustness, as well as conducting prospective trials to assess AI's true impact on clinical outcomes.

cards.headline: Und als sie gegen Galut und seine Heerscharen auf dem Plan erschienen …

source.title: Sure Al-Baqarah, 2:250
source.excerpt: ولما ظهروا لجالوت وجنوده، ورأوا الخطر رأي العين، فزعوا إلى الله بالدعاء والضراعة قائلين: ربنا أنزل على قلوبنا صبرًا عظيمًا، وثبت أقدامنا، واجعلها راسخة في قتال العدو، لا تفر مِن هول الحرب، وانصرنا بعونك وتأييدك على القوم الكافرين.

cards.arabic: وَلَمَّا بَرَزُوا۟ لِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ قَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَآ أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا وَٱنصُرْنَا عَلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
cards.translation: Und als sie gegen Galut und seine Heerscharen auf dem Plan erschienen, sagten sie: „Unser Herr, überschütte uns mit Standhaftigkeit, festige unsere Füße und verhilf uns zum Sieg über das ungläubige Volk!
cards.reflection: Was nimmst du heute aus diesem Vers mit?
cards.body: When the faithful party, who were few under the command of Talut, faced their enemy, who were many under the command of Jalut, قَالُواْ رَبَّنَآ أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا (they invoked: "Our Lord! Pour forth on us patience...") meaning, send down patience on us from You.

cards.headline: Und so schlugen sie sie mit Allahs Erlaubnis, und Dawud tötete Galut.

source.title: Sure Al-Baqarah, 2:251
source.excerpt: فهزموهم بإذن الله، وقتل داود -عليه السلام- جالوتَ قائدَ الجبابرة، وأعطى الله عز وجل داود بعد ذلك الملك والنبوة في بني إسرائيل، وعَلَّمه مما يشاء من العلوم. ولولا أن يدفع الله ببعض الناس -وهم أهل الطاعة له والإيمان به- بعضًا، وهم أهل المعصية لله والشرك به، لفسدت الأرض بغلبة الكفر، وتمكُّن الطغيان، وأهل المعاصي، ولكن الله ذو فضل على المخلوقين جميعًا.

cards.arabic: فَهَزَمُوهُم بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ وَقَتَلَ دَاوُۥدُ جَالُوتَ وَءَاتَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمُلْكَ وَٱلْحِكْمَةَ وَعَلَّمَهُۥ مِمَّا يَشَآءُ ۗ وَلَوْلَا دَفْعُ ٱللَّهِ ٱلنَّاسَ بَعْضَهُم بِبَعْضٍ لَّفَسَدَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَلَـٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ ذُو فَضْلٍ عَلَى ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
cards.translation: Und so schlugen sie sie mit Allahs Erlaubnis, und Dawud tötete Galut. Und Allah gab ihm die Herrschaft und die Weisheit und lehrte ihn von dem, was Er wollte. Und wenn nicht Allah die einen Menschen durch die anderen zurückweisen würde, geriete die Erde wahrlich ins Verderben. Aber Allah ist voll Huld gegen die Weltenbewohner.
